title: Prepare separate-brand Amplify hosting with explicit setup gates
description:
As a brand operator I want Prospectus delivered separately from Papyrus so public sites integrate through links or an API.

Feature: Separate Prospectus delivery
  Scenario: Build the hosting artifact
    Given the local Prospectus project and configured Kanbus package
    When the Amplify frontend build runs
    Then a deployable static app artifact is produced
    And no production deployment or access grant is created
  Scenario: Review production setup
    Given a future cloud release
    When operators review setup requirements
    Then repository visibility, AWS account, API storage, authentication and inbound protection are explicit
    And shared Cognito remains undecided
